image_description: A silver chain necklace displayed on a white mannequin bust. The necklace features a large, round, dark pendant with radial grooves (resembling a sea urchin shell or carved stone) and two smaller, irregular black bead-like charms higher up the chain. The chain appears to be a fine link style with small spacer beads.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The necklace is clearly visible draped over the mannequin's shoulder and chest area, exhibiting natural gravity-driven curvature.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A prominent large, dark, circular pendant hangs centrally at the bottom of the visible loop.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The radial pattern on the large pendant is slightly soft and lacks the crisp micro-texture expected of carved stone or shell, appearing somewhat smudged or digitally painted rather than physically detailed.

artifact_observations.location: Connection point of upper black charms
artifact_observations.reasoning: The two smaller black charms appear to float or merge slightly with the chain without clear, distinct jump rings or attachment points, suggesting a minor fusion artifact common in AI generation.
Some chain segments fade into the background with inconsistent depth-of-field blur, typical of AI images struggling with fine linear details in out-of-focus areas.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of jewelry and rule out misclassification as other accessories.
To verify the physical connectivity of the chain links and ensure the pendants are properly attached without floating artifacts.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies in the metal and stone materials.
To ensure the necklace sits correctly on the 3D surface of the mannequin without clipping or impossible floating.

focus_areas: Connectivity of chain links (no fused segments)
Attachment points of pendants (clear jump rings/hooks)
Surface reflectivity of metal (consistent specular highlights)
Texture detail of the large pendant (radial grooves)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'floating' appearance of the upper black charms; do they have valid physical connections to the chain? Also, evaluate if the radial pattern on the main pendant looks like a natural material (shell/stone) or a generated texture smear.
